title: Sparkly piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x='12' y='35' width='76' height='45' rx='6' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <!-- Piano top edge highlight -->
  <rect x='12' y='35' width='76' height='8' rx='4' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- Piano lid line -->
  <rect x='16' y='42' width='68' height='3' rx='1' fill='#6B3410'/>
  
  <!-- White keys area -->
  <rect x='16' y='50' width='68' height='24' rx='3' fill='#F5F0E0'/>
  
  <!-- White keys (individual) -->
  <rect x='17' y='51' width='8' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='26' y='51' width='8' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='35' y='51' width='8' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='44' y='51' width='8' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='53' y='51' width='8' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='62' y='51' width='8' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='71' y='51' width='12' height='22' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Key separators -->
  <rect x='25' y='51' width='1' height='22' fill='#D0C8B0'/>

  <rect x='43' y='51' width='1' height='22' fill='#D0C8B0'/>

  <rect x='70' y='51' width='1' height='22' fill='#D0C8B0'/>
  
  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x='22' y='51' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#3A2A5A'/>
  <rect x='31' y='51' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#3A2A5A'/>
  <rect x='48' y='51' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#3A2A5A'/>
  <rect x='57' y='51' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#3A2A5A'/>
  <rect x='66' y='51' width='6' height='14' rx='1' fill='#3A2A5A'/>
  
  <!-- Black key highlights -->
  <rect x='23' y='52' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5A4A8A'/>
  <rect x='32' y='52' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5A4A8A'/>
  <rect x='49' y='52' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5A4A8A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='52' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5A4A8A'/>
  <rect x='67' y='52' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5A4A8A'/>
  
  <!-- Piano legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='80' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#7B3F10'/>
  <rect x='74' y='80' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#7B3F10'/>
  
  <!-- Music stand -->
  <rect x='35' y='25' width='30' height='12' rx='3' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <rect x='37' y='27' width='26' height='8' rx='2' fill='#FFF8E8'/>

  <ellipse cx='43' cy='31' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <rect x='44.5' y='27' width='1' height='6' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='30' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <rect x='53.5' y='26' width='1' height='6' fill='#8B4513'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <polygon points='18,18 20,24 26,26 20,28 18,34 16,28 10,26 16,24' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='26' r='2' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <polygon points='78,12 80,18 86,20 80,22 78,28 76,22 70,20 76,18' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='2' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 3 - right side -->
  <polygon points='88,45 89.5,49 93,50 89.5,51 88,55 86.5,51 83,50 86.5,49' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 4 - left side -->
  <polygon points='8,55 9.5,59 13,60 9.5,61 8,65 6.5,61 3,60 6.5,59' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle 5 - bottom -->
  <polygon points='50,88 51.5,92 55,93 51.5,94 50,98 48.5,94 45,93 48.5,92' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='93' r='1.5' fill='#FFFACD'/>
  
  <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='5' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
</svg>
